intercity_routes.recommendation: Best overall balance of speed, comfort, and center-to-center convenience. If traveling round-trip or connecting to a 3rd city, check the KORAIL Saver Pass (for 2-5 travelers) to save up to 40,000+ KRW.
intercity_routes.sf_japan_comparison: Similar to riding the Tokaido Shinkansen from Tokyo to Kyoto, but ~50% cheaper.

intercity_routes.iphone_app: SRT (Korean only - book via website in English)
intercity_routes.recommendation: About 10% cheaper than KTX and departs from Gangnam (Suseo). Highly recommended if your hotel is in southern Seoul, though tickets sell out very quickly.
intercity_routes.sf_japan_comparison: Like an alternative Shinkansen line departing from a southern hub station.

intercity_routes.recommendation: Feature 160-degree flat reclining individual pods with privacy curtains and personal entertainment screens. Best budget option with luxury comfort.
intercity_routes.sf_japan_comparison: Far more luxurious than greyhound/California buses; comparable to Japan's premium highway luxury coaches.

intercity_routes.mode: Domestic Flight (Korean Air, Asiana, Air Busan, Jeju Air)
intercity_routes.duration: 1 hr flight (approx 3 hr 30 min total door-to-door)
intercity_routes.recommendation: Flight time is only 60 mins, but add airport transit and security time. Good if you find a sale (~35,000 KRW one-way), but KTX is more relaxing and drops you in central Busan.
intercity_routes.sf_japan_comparison: Like flying SFO to LAX on a short shuttle flight.

intercity_routes.recommendation: The fastest way to reach historic Gyeongju (Option A for 3rd City). From Singyeongju Station, take Bus 700 or a 15-minute taxi into the historic UNESCO center.
intercity_routes.sf_japan_comparison: Like taking the Shinkansen from Tokyo to Kyoto's historic temple districts.

intercity_routes.recommendation: Lightning-fast 35-minute hop! Makes Busan <-> Gyeongju an effortless combination on your itinerary.
intercity_routes.sf_japan_comparison: Shorter and faster than BART from downtown SF to SFO.

intercity_routes.frequency: World's busiest air route (flights every 5-10 minutes)
intercity_routes.recommendation: Essential mode if you select Jeju Island as your 3rd city. Book early for peak autumn foliage weekends in November.
intercity_routes.sf_japan_comparison: Like flying from Tokyo to Okinawa or SFO to Honolulu, but with 10x flight frequency.

intercity_routes.recommendation: The culinary capital of Korea (Option C for 3rd City). Quick 1 hour 40 min train from Yongsan Station in Seoul.
intercity_routes.sf_japan_comparison: Like taking an express train from Tokyo to a historic gourmet town like Kanazawa.

intercity_routes.recommendation: Reserved comfortable seats! Much faster and more relaxing than taking the All-Stop Subway Line 1 (which takes 60 mins).
intercity_routes.sf_japan_comparison: Like taking a JR Limited Express train from Tokyo to Kamakura.

intercity_routes.recommendation: Korea's only double-decker express train! Drops you at Gapyeong Station where you take a 5-minute taxi or bus to the Nami Island ferry.
intercity_routes.sf_japan_comparison: Like the double-decker Green Car on JR Shonan-Shinjuku Line.

intercity_routes.to: Sokcho Express Bus Terminal (Seoraksan National Park)
intercity_routes.recommendation: The most comfortable way to reach Seoraksan National Park for dramatic November mountain foliage.
intercity_routes.sf_japan_comparison: Like taking a highway coach from Tokyo to Hakone or Fuji Five Lakes.

airport_to_city_routes.recommendation: Official adult fare is 13,000 KRW on airportrailroad.com/train/express/introduce (child 9,500 KRW). Reserved seating and dedicated luggage racks. Published timetable: first Express T2 05:16 / T1 05:24; last Express T2 22:40 / T1 22:48 — confirm the live table before you fly.
airport_to_city_routes.sf_japan_comparison: Direct equivalent to Tokyo's Narita Express (N'EX) or Skyliner.

airport_to_city_routes.recommendation: Official adult IC-card fare is 4,750 KRW Seoul–T1 and 5,350 KRW Seoul–T2 (airportrailroad.com fare table). The old 4,450 figure is the Cargo Terminal fare, not ICN. Stops at Hongik Univ. and Gongdeok. Pay with T-money or WOWPASS. Last all-stop from T2 is about 23:32.
airport_to_city_routes.sf_japan_comparison: Like BART from SFO to downtown SF or Tokyo's Keisei Main Line.

airport_to_city_routes.recommendation: No stairs or subway transfers! Driver loads your heavy bags underneath and drops you directly in front of major hotels.
airport_to_city_routes.sf_japan_comparison: Direct equivalent to Japan's Airport Limousine Bus from Narita/Haneda to Shinjuku hotels.

airport_to_city_routes.mode: Official Airport Taxi / Kakao T / Uber
airport_to_city_routes.recommendation: Total metered cost is ~60,000 to 70,000 KRW including highway toll. Split between 2 travelers ($23/person), it is extremely convenient if you have heavy luggage after a transpacific flight.
airport_to_city_routes.sf_japan_comparison: Way cheaper than taking an Uber from SFO to Marin or Tokyo Narita taxi ($200+).
